issues.title: KOSPI Regains 4,900 Level as KOSDAQ Surges 8 Percent on Hopes for Stock Stabilization Fund
issues.titleKo: 증안펀드 기대에 코스피가 4,900선을 회복하고 코스닥이 8% 급등했다
issues.summary: The KOSPI closed up 4.34 percent at 4,915.68 and the KOSDAQ rose 8.13 percent to 708.99 on the 27th. Analysts attributed the gains to heavy net buying by foreign investors and expectations that the Securities Market Stabilization Fund would be expanded.
issues.why: Swings in the stock market can affect not only the assets of college students who invest in stocks and funds but also pensions and the job outlook.

paragraphs.en: South Korean stocks rebounded sharply on the 27th. The KOSPI closed at 4,915.68, up 204.47 points, or 4.34 percent, from the previous session, regaining the 4,900 level on a closing basis for the first time in three trading days. The KOSDAQ surged 53.28 points, or 8.13 percent, to end at 708.99, and a buy-side sidecar was triggered at around 10:22 a.m.
paragraphs.ko: 국내 증시가 27일 크게 반등했다. 코스피는 전장보다 204.47포인트(4.34%) 오른 4,915.68에 마감해 종가 기준 3거래일 만에 4,900선을 되찾았다. 코스닥은 53.28포인트(8.13%) 급등한 708.99로 끝났고, 오전 10시 22분쯤 매수 사이드카가 발동됐다.

paragraphs.en: In the KOSPI market, foreign investors were net buyers of 1.1299 trillion won worth of shares, which Yonhap News Agency reported was the largest since Sept. 7. On the KOSDAQ, foreigners and institutions bought 307.4 billion won and 586.8 billion won, respectively, while individuals sold 884.4 billion won worth. Samsung Electronics rose 4.55 percent and SK hynix gained 5.41 percent, while Jusung Engineering and Samchundang Pharm were among KOSDAQ stocks that jumped more than 10 percent.

issues.title: School Contract Workers Hold One-Day Strike, Disrupting Meals at About 3 in 10 Schools Nationwide
issues.titleKo: 학교 비정규직이 하루 총파업에 나서 전국 학교 10곳 중 3곳에서 급식에 차질이 빚어졌다
issues.summary: School non-regular workers staged a one-day general strike on the 27th after collective wage talks broke down. The Ministry of Education counted 23,562 participants, and school meals and after-school care were disrupted.
issues.why: The treatment of school meal and care workers is tied to how schools operate and to the wider issue of discrimination against non-regular workers in Korea.

paragraphs.en: School non-regular workers who handle meals and child care staged a one-day general strike on the 27th. The Ministry of Education said that as of 11 a.m., 23,562 of 180,722 education public service workers, or 13.0 percent, had taken part. The union coalition had held collective wage talks with the ministry and 16 city and provincial education offices since September but failed to reach an agreement.
paragraphs.ko: 급식과 돌봄을 맡는 학교 비정규직 노동자들이 27일 하루 총파업에 나섰다. 교육부는 오전 11시 기준 교육공무직원 18만722명 중 2만3천562명(13.0%)이 참여했다고 밝혔다. 연대회의는 지난 9월부터 교육부, 16개 시도교육청과 집단임금교섭을 했지만 합의에 이르지 못했다.

paragraphs.en: Of the 12,597 schools that run meal services, 4,014, or 31.9 percent, had disruptions, serving substitute meals such as bread and milk. By region, only 32.1 percent of schools in Gangwon served regular meals, compared with 49.9 percent in North Jeolla and 50.6 percent in North Chungcheong. Elementary after-school care classrooms did not operate at 201 schools, and 753 of the 13,101 classrooms nationwide failed to open. After-school programs at kindergartens were suspended at 27 sites.
paragraphs.ko: 급식을 운영하는 학교 1만2천597곳 중 4천14곳(31.9%)이 빵과 우유 같은 대체식 등으로 급식에 차질을 빚었다. 지역별로는 강원에서 정상 급식을 한 학교가 32.1%에 그쳤고, 전북은 49.9%, 충북은 50.6%였다. 초등 돌봄교실은 학교 201곳이 운영하지 못했고, 전체 1만3천101개 교실 중 753개가 문을 열지 못했다. 유치원 방과후 과정은 27곳이 운영을 멈췄다.

paragraphs.en: The sticking point is the size of the pay raise. According to the Korea Economic Daily, the coalition demanded a 105,000 won, or 4.9 percent, increase in monthly base pay. Education authorities offered a proposal raised from 49,300 won (2.3 percent) to 64,300 won (3.0 percent), but the union objected that this falls short of the 3.9 percent raise in civil servant pay next year. The union is also demanding higher seniority allowances, an end to discrimination in holiday bonuses and improvements to the work system during school vacations.

issues.title: Cheating Cases on College Entrance Exam Reach 474 as Ministry Pushes Smart-Glasses Detection Technology
issues.titleKo: 수능 부정행위가 474건에 이르자 교육부가 스마트안경 탐지 기술 상용화를 추진한다
issues.summary: The Ministry of Education said on the 27th that 474 cases of cheating were caught on this year's college entrance exam, up 69.9 percent from last year. The government is pushing to commercialize smart-glasses detection technology and strengthen penalties.
issues.why: Supervision methods are changing even for university-specific exams and school tests, directly affecting the exam environment for test takers and college students.

paragraphs.en: Acting Education Minister Choi Eun-ok said at a plenary meeting of the National Assembly's Education Committee on the 27th that 474 cases of cheating had been detected on the college entrance exam for the 2027 academic year as of the 25th. That is up 69.9 percent from 279 cases last year. Smart-device-related cheating rose 3.6 times, from 31 cases to 112.

issues.titleKo: 정년연장특위의 노사 협의가 합의 없이 끝났고 다음 달 마지막 회의가 열린다
issues.summary: The Democratic Party's special committee on extending the retirement age held labor-management talks for the first time in 10 months but failed to reach an agreement on the 27th. The committee plans to hold a final plenary meeting on the 2nd of next month.
issues.why: The income gap between the statutory retirement age and the start of pension payments is a problem that will continue to affect the job market and retirement prospects of young people who are about to enter the workforce.

paragraphs.en: The Democratic Party's special committee on extending the retirement age held a closed-door labor-management subcommittee meeting at the National Assembly on the morning of the 27th to discuss a mediation proposal, but failed to find common ground. Rep. Kim Joo-young, the committee's secretary, said the two sides' positions did not narrow despite about 1 hour and 30 minutes of discussion. He said a final plenary meeting is planned for the 2nd of next month.
paragraphs.ko: 더불어민주당 정년연장특별위원회는 27일 오전 국회에서 비공개 노사 소위원회를 열어 정년연장 중재안을 논의했지만 합의점을 찾지 못했다. 특위 간사 김주영 의원은 약 1시간 30분 논의했는데도 양쪽 입장이 좁혀지지 않았다고 밝혔다. 그는 다음 달 2일 마지막으로 전체회의를 열 예정이라고 했다.

paragraphs.en: The current statutory retirement age is 60, while the age at which people can begin receiving the National Pension is 63 this year and will become 65 in 2033. Retiring at 60 leaves an income gap of up to five years before pension payments begin, which is the starting point of the discussion. The Democratic Party's mediation proposal would raise the statutory retirement age to 61 in 2029 and then by one year every two years, reaching 65 in 2037. It would also gradually raise the age for mandatory rehiring after retirement starting in 2028. The party is also considering a special provision that would ease the procedure for changing employment rules only for those covered by the extension.

issues.summary: The Scientists and Engineers Mutual Aid Association said on the 27th that its server was hacked and about 210,000 member records were leaked. issues.why: Any service you use can be hacked at any time, so it helps to avoid reusing the same password and to be suspicious of impersonation attempts.

issues.title: Patients to Pay Less for Appendectomy and C-Section From January as Bundled Fees Are Overhauled
issues.titleKo: 내년 1월부터 맹장·제왕절개 수술 환자 부담 줄어
issues.summary: The Ministry of Health and Welfare has decided to overhaul bundled payment rates for seven disease groups for the first time in six years. The patient's share for a laparoscopic appendectomy will fall from 1.22 million won to 870,000 won.
issues.why: The change alters what patients pay for sudden surgery or childbirth, so it bears directly on medical costs for college students and their families.

paragraphs.en: The Ministry of Health and Welfare decided on the 27th, at a meeting of the Health Insurance Policy Deliberation Committee, to overhaul the bundled payment rates for seven disease groups for the first time in six years. Under the bundled payment system, inpatient treatment costs are set as a package for each type of surgery, and the revision takes effect in January next year. The ministry estimated that the changes will cost the national health insurance finances an additional 113.2 billion won a year.

issues.title: Yonsei University Plans 130 Billion Won Over Eight Years for a Human-Centered AI Campus
issues.titleKo: 연세대, 8년간 1,300억 원 들여 사람 중심 AI 캠퍼스 추진
issues.summary: Yonsei University held a ceremony on the 27th at its Sinchon campus to announce a vision for a human-centered AI campus, saying it will invest more than 130 billion won over eight years from 2026. AI will be introduced across education, research and administration.
issues.why: Required liberal arts courses for freshmen and AI-centered campus operations are changing how classes and schools run, which directly affects how college students learn.

paragraphs.en: Yonsei University held a ceremony on the morning of the 27th at the Baekyang Nuri Grand Ballroom on its Sinchon campus to announce its vision for a human-centered AI campus. President Yun Dong-sub put forward the school motto, truth that sets free and intellect that serves, as the vision for the AI era. He said the goal is to nurture people who ask questions and verify for themselves rather than simply accept the answers AI gives. More than 130 billion won will be invested over eight years starting in 2026.
paragraphs.ko: 연세대학교는 27일 오전 신촌캠퍼스 백양누리 그랜드볼룸에서 사람 중심 AI 캠퍼스 비전 선포식을 열었다. 윤동섭 총장은 학교 교훈인 '자유케 하는 진리, 섬기는 지성'을 AI 시대의 비전으로 내세웠다. 그는 AI의 답을 그냥 받아들이지 않고 스스로 질문하고 검증하는 인재를 키우는 것이 목표라고 밝혔다. 2026년부터 8년간 1,300억 원 이상이 투입된다.

issues.summary: Nvidia has reportedly halted shipments of AI servers to Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand and Indonesia in line with new U.S. export controls on AI chips. Chip sellers were also said to have told cloud companies that they will not sell chips to those that lease computing capacity to Chinese firms.
issues.why: Because limits on AI chip supply affect AI services, data center investment and jobs at related companies worldwide, they could also reach the AI environment we use.

paragraphs.en: Britain's Financial Times reported on the 26th (local time) that Nvidia had instructed server-making partners such as Dell and Supermicro to stop shipping AI servers to Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand and Indonesia. The partners reportedly told local customers that Nvidia was not allowing the ordered volumes to ship.

paragraphs.en: Behind the move is a tightened export control rule that the U.S. Department of Commerce put into effect on the 19th. Chinese AI developers had been using Nvidia chips by renting data centers from local cloud companies in Southeast Asia. The new rule requires separate licenses for advanced AI chips going to the four countries and Brazil, and requires cloud operators to prove within 90 days that none of their end users are subject to sanctions. Nvidia declined to comment, and it is unclear whether the halt will be temporary.

issues.title: Real Household Income Falls 2.1% in Third Quarter, First Decline in 10 Quarters
issues.summary: According to the National Data Agency, real household income fell 2.1% in the third quarter from a year earlier, the first decline in 10 quarters. The monthly average income of the bottom 20% of households fell 2.7%, the only bracket to decline.
issues.why: When income adjusted for prices falls, living costs and spending power get tighter, and a growing burden on lower-income households could also affect the finances of young people.

paragraphs.en: The National Data Agency said households' real income in the third quarter of this year fell 2.1% from a year earlier. It was the first decline in 10 quarters, and the size of the drop was the largest in 13 quarters, since the second quarter of 2023.

sents.ko: 국가데이터처는 올해 3분기 가구의 실질소득이 1년 전보다 2.1% 줄었다고 밝혔다.

paragraphs.en: In nominal terms, earned income rose 3.6%, but business income fell 1.4%, declining for the first time in 12 quarters. The agency explained that this reflected a slowdown in growth in the number of self-employed people and higher business costs stemming from changes in prices and interest rates.

issues.title: Six Korea University Students Who Opposed Yushin Rule Cleared of Charges in Retrial After 52 Years
issues.titleKo: 유신에 반대한 고려대 학생 6명, 52년 만에 재심에서 무죄
issues.summary: The Seoul High Court on the 27th acquitted six Korea University students in a retrial after they were convicted for opposing the Yushin system of the 1970s. The court acknowledged illegal detention and abusive treatment and apologized for the unlawful acts of state agencies.
issues.why: The ruling shows a court correcting a state human rights violation from the democratization era, prompting a look back at how university students' freedom of expression and association was defended.

paragraphs.en: The Seoul High Court's Criminal Division 11-1, presiding Judge Kim Tae-ho, on the 27th acquitted six people, including Yoo Young-rae, in a retrial. They had been suspected of insurrection conspiracy and violations of the National Security Act and the Anti-Communist Act. The six, then students at Korea University in the early 1970s, were convicted over their activities in the "Black October Group." They have now been cleared after 52 years.
paragraphs.ko: 서울고법 형사11-1부(재판장 김태호)는 27일 유영래씨 등 6명에 대한 재심에서 무죄를 선고했다. 이들은 내란음모, 국가보안법 및 반공법 위반 등 혐의를 받았다. 이들은 1970년대 초 고려대 재학 중 '검은 10월단' 활동을 이유로 유죄가 확정됐다. 52년 만에 누명을 벗은 것이다.

issues.summary: Prime Minister Han Seong-sook on the 27th told a housing supply review meeting to see this year's supply target through to the end and to begin preparing for next year in advance. She said the Seoul housing market is showing a stronger trend of downward stabilization in some areas.
issues.why: Housing prices and supply plans bear on the housing costs and move-in opportunities university students will face when they live independently or prepare for marriage.

paragraphs.en: Prime Minister Han Seong-sook on the 27th told officials to make an all-out effort for the rest of the year to meet this year's housing supply target. She spoke at the fifth inter-ministerial meeting to review rapid housing supply, held at the Government Complex Seoul. She also said the status of progress should be disclosed transparently so the public can see it directly and feel reassured.

issues.why: Knowing the procedures and legal reasoning of insurrection-related criminal trials can help readers follow related news calmly.

paragraphs.en: The special counsel team led by Cho Eun-suk, which is investigating the insurrection case, on the 27th sought a 10-year prison term for Hwang Kyo-ahn, leader of the Liberty and Innovation party. The request came at a closing hearing before Criminal Division 35 of the Seoul Central District Court, presided over by Judge Baek Dae-hyun. The charges are inciting insurrection and obstructing the execution of special official duties.
paragraphs.ko: 조은석 내란특별검사팀은 27일 황교안 자유와혁신 대표에게 징역 10년을 구형했다. 구형은 서울중앙지법 형사합의35부(백대현 부장판사) 심리로 열린 결심 공판에서 나왔다. 혐의는 내란선동과 특수공무집행방해다.
